heroHeadline: Tanker Struck Off Qatar as Iran Threatens Full Strait of Hormuz Closure
heroSubtitle: UKMTO reports a tanker hit by multiple projectiles off north Qatar; Iran separately signals the oil route through the Strait of Hormuz will be 'closed', marking the most direct full-blockade threat since the crisis began
